title: Egorov's theorem on ℝⁿ with a closed good set and uniform convergence on its compact subsets
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, let C ⊆ ℝⁿ be Borel, and let F_k : ℝⁿ → ℝ (k ∈ ℕ) and G : ℝⁿ → ℝ be Borel functions with F_k(x) → G(x) for every x ∈ C. Then for every real ε > 0 there is a closed set A ⊆ C such that Lⁿ(C∖A) < ε and F_k → G uniformly on every compact subset of A.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (C : Set (Rn n)) (F : ℕ → Rn n → ℝ) (G : Rn n → ℝ), MeasurableSet C → (∀ k, Measurable (F k)) → Measurable G → (∀ x ∈ C, Tendsto (fun k ↦ F k x) atTop (𝓝 (G x))) → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ A ⊆ C, IsClosed A ∧ volume (C \ A) < ENNReal.ofReal ε ∧ ∀ K ⊆ A, IsCompact K → TendstoUniformlyOn F G atTop K
